page.title: Community catalog
page.description: Business templates and modules published in the index configured in this installation. Templates are installed and updated with versioning; modules are only listed with instructions.
page.disabledDescription: The installation administrator turned the catalog off (CATALOG_INDEX_URL empty or off).

rejected.title_one: {{count}} index entry was ignored because it is invalid
rejected.title_other: {{count}} index entries were ignored because they are invalid

templates.title: Business templates
templates.description: Versioned configuration packages. Before installing, Aphel downloads the package, checks its SHA-256 and minimum version and shows the comparison with what already exists.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Aphel never downloads or runs code from the catalog. A module is installed by declaring it in back/aphel.modules.toml, compiling the binary and enabling it in Integrations > Modules.
modules.howTo: To include it in the binary, add it to back/aphel.modules.toml and run make modules:

outdated: The organization changed since the comparison. We compared again; review before applying.
